hints.title: Log Category Discrimination
hints.text: Distinguish letter logs from digit logs by inspecting the first word after the identifier.

hints.title: Custom Compound Sorting Key
hints.text: All letter logs must precede digit logs. Digit logs maintain their original order. Letter logs are ordered by their contents, using their identifier as a tie-breaker.

hints.title: Stable Multi-Key Ordering
hints.text: Split each log on the first space. If the second token starts with a digit, tag it with category 1. If it starts with a letter, tag it with category 0 and sort key (contents, identifier). Sort with a stable comparison.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: maximum length of a single log
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unstable sorting can violate the requirement that digit logs retain their relative original order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructing tuple sort keys provides clean lexicographical ordering with memory linear in total input characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle custom compound sort keys and understand the importance of stable sorting for digit-logs.
complexity.notes: In Python, Python’s Timsort is stable by specification.
